entries.jp:
沖田に敗れた二人の身体は
ぐずぐずと崩れてゆく……
井伊に力を与えられた時
すでに彼らは　人間では
なくなっていたのだろう
entries.en:
Beaten by Okita,
the two men's
bodies crumbled
away... They had
likely stopped
being human
when Ii gave
them power.

entries.jp:
今まで数え切れないほど
人を斬り命を奪ってきた
そこには迷いも憐れみも
無く　悼みの心など一度も
持ったことはない
entries.en:
I've cut down
more people than
I can count. I
never felt doubt
or pity, and never
once mourned a
single one.

entries.jp: 近藤さんと同じとこに\n行けるように……
entries.en: That you'll make\nit to where\nKondo-san is...

entries.jp: 沖田の目から\n幾筋も涙がこぼれ落ち\n仲間の身体と共に消えていく
entries.en:
Tear after tear
fell from Okita's
eyes, vanishing
along with his
comrades' bodies.

entries.jp: そしたら　君達は\n僕を出し抜けるよ
entries.en: Then you'll have\ngotten one over\non me.

entries.jp: 近藤さんに一足早く\n会えるんだから……
entries.en: Since you'll get to\nsee Kondo-san\nbefore I do...

entries.jp:
思わず目を閉じた沖田の涙を
隊士達の溶けた身体を
攫うように
大きな風が吹き抜けた
entries.en:
Okita shut his
eyes as a great
wind swept
through, carrying
off his tears and
the troopers'
melted bodies.

entries.jp: いま　近藤さんの声が……

目を開けると　そこは
何もない街道だった
沖田の涙も　まるで
誰かが拭ってくれたように
吹き飛んでいた
entries.en:
When he opened
his eyes, he stood
on an empty
highway. Okita's
tears were gone,
as if someone had
wiped them away.

entries.jp: 沖田は空を見上げて\nもう一度\n月へと語りかける
entries.en:
Okita looked up
at the sky and
spoke to the moon
once more.

entries.jp: どんなに闇が暗くても\nどんなに道が険しくても\nもう　見失うことはない
entries.en:
No matter how
dark the night, no
matter how steep
the road, I won't
lose my way
again.

entries.jp: 僕の心に……闇の中にも\n貴方という月は\n輝き続けるから
entries.en:
Because in my
heart... even in
the dark, the
moon that is you
will keep on
shining.
